response.raw_text: {"overall_diagnosis":"The recurring issue across diagnoses is incomplete guidance in d3-visualization/SKILL.md for interactive D3 bubble/table visualizations. The documentation underspecifies how to implement reliable clickable SVG marks when labels overlay bubbles, how to prevent text from intercepting pointer events, and how to structure deterministic bidirectional linking between a chart and an adjacent table. These gaps can produce broken hover/click behavior, desynchronized highlighting, and inconsistent evaluation outcomes for linked interactive visualizations.","diagnosed_skills":[{"path":"d3-visualization/SKILL.md","confidence":"0.89","diagnosis":"The skill guide lacks sufficiently concrete, testable guidance for clickable bubble charts with overlaid labels and linked tables. Common D3 pitfalls are not clearly addressed: text labels intercepting pointer events, incorrect z-ordering between circles and labels, inconsistent selection state between chart and table, and missing deterministic keyed joins and acceptance checks for two-way interaction.","repair_instruction":"Revise the sections on clickable graphics, text overlay layers, and chart↔table interactions to include deterministic implementation patterns: attach interaction handlers to a parent <g> or mark layer; use stable key functions such as ticker in all .data(..., keyFn) joins; define a single shared selection state (e.g., selectedTicker) with centralized update functions like setSelected() and clearSelection(); append circles before labels or use separate layers; explicitly set pointer-events:none on text labels so labels remain visible without blocking hover/click; apply synchronized CSS classes to both bubbles and table rows; use cursor:pointer on interactive marks; and add an acceptance checklist covering bubble→row highlighting, row→bubble highlighting, optional scroll-into-view behavior, deterministic updates, repeated selection behavior, and verification that label overlays do not block interactions or tooltips."}],"unselected_skills":["d3-visualization/scripts/bubble_chart_example.js","d3-visualization/scripts/check_tooltip.js","d3-visualization/scripts/interactive_table_example.js","d3-visualization/scripts/tooltip_handler.js"]}
